notes.title: 🎉 Exciting News for All "IT Clicker: Dinosaur in the Code World" Fans! 🦖💻
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce a major update to our beloved game. The world of coding and dinosaurs is now even more accessible and engaging:

✨ The game now supports 4 languages: Russian 🇷🇺, English 🇬🇧, German 🇩🇪, and French 🇫🇷. We want everyone to enjoy our adventures in the most comfortable way possible.

🍏 Great news for Mac users — "IT Clicker: Dinosaur in the Code World" is now available on macOS! Get ready to dive into the game without leaving your favorite computer.

We are grateful to our community for the support and feedback that made this moment possible. Keep sending us your ideas and suggestions, and let's continue to make our game even better together!
